cohort: The study included all women who delivered or experienced maternal death in the US between 2004 and 2014.
finding: Pregnant patients with cystic fibrosis have an increased risk of developing adverse maternal and delivery outcomes, including gestational diabetes mellitus, placenta previa, preterm delivery, operative vaginal delivery, and death.
mod_finding: Cystic fibrosis was associated with an increased risk of operative vaginal delivery and a decreased likelihood of spontaneous vaginal delivery.
